name: diff
title: Diff
description: Compare the two things you copied last, with changed lines tinted and the differing words marked. Also diff the clipboard against a selection, any two history entries, or two files.
author: pal

settings.label: External tool
settings.description: What `o` opens the two sides in. Auto takes the first installed of VS Code (`code --diff`), kitty (`+kitten diff`), FileMerge (`opendiff`, with Xcode) and Meld.

settings.label: Custom command
settings.description: With the custom tool: the command line, `{left}` and `{right}` standing for the two files (a quoted argument stays whole).

store.tagline: Diff the two things you just copied
features: Opens on the two newest text copies, the older on the left
Other pairs: the clipboard against the selection (`e`), two history entries (`h`), two files (`f`)
Changed words marked inside each line; unified or side by side (`s`); `w` ignores whitespace
Unchanged stretches fold away; `tab` walks them, `space` expands one
`enter` copies the unified diff; `o` opens both sides in VS Code, kitty, FileMerge or Meld

actions.title: Open in external tool
actions.description: The two sides as files in VS Code, kitty, FileMerge, Meld or the custom command.

actions.title: Ignore whitespace / Mind whitespace
actions.description: Leading and trailing whitespace on a line does not count.

actions.title: Expand the fold under the cursor
actions.description: `tab` and `shift+tab` move the cursor over the folds; `a` expands every fold; a click expands one.

screenshots.caption: The two newest copies diffed: the older on the left, the words that changed marked, unchanged runs folded
s puts the sides next to each other
Every key on ⌘K: copy the unified diff or either side, open both in your diff tool, other sources
Any two from the clipboard history: pick the left, then the right, or mark two and press Enter

clipboard.description: Diff the two newest text copies in the clipboard history

selection.description: Diff the clipboard against the selection in the app in front

text.description: Diff two texts given in the link

left_label.description: What to call the left side

right_label.description: What to call the right side

history.description: Diff two clipboard history entries by id

diff.description: The two newest copies diffed; keys for other pairs, side by side, whitespace, the folds, the tool.
